title: TROUBLESHOOTING (Cont'd)
ocr_text:
TROUBLESHOOTING (Cont'd)

Problem | Possible cause | Remedy | Page

Excessive oil consumption | Oil leak | Repair as necessary | LU-7
 | PCV line clogged | Check PCV system | EC-5
 | Piston rings worn or damaged | Check rings | EM-63
 | Valve stem and guide worn | Check valves | EM-32
 | Valve stem seal worn | Check seals | EM-32

Poor fuel economy | Fuel leak | Repair as necessary |
 | Air cleaner clogged | Check air cleaner | MA-5
 | Incorrect ignition timing | Reset timing | IG-20
 | EFI system problems | Repair as necessary |
 | • Injector faulty |
 | • Deceleration fuel cut system faulty |
 | Idle speed too high | Check ISC system | FI-106
 | Spark plugs faulty | Inspect plugs | IG-7
 | EGR system always on | Check EGR system | EC-12, 16
 | Low compression | Check compression | EM-20, 21
 | Tires improperly inflated | Inflate tires to proper pressure |
 | Clutch slips | Troubleshoot clutch |
 | Brakes drag | Troubleshoot brakes |

Unpleasant odor | Incorrect idle speed | Check ISC system | FI-106
 | Incorrect ignition timing | Reset timing | IG-20
 | Vacuum leak | Repair as necessary |
 | • PCV hoses |
 | • EGR valve |
 | • Intake manifold |
 | • Air intake chamber |
 | • Throttle body |
 | EFI system problems | Repair as necessary |
